s: Which of the following mountain passes forms the "Tri- Junction" of India, China and Myanmar?
x: Diphu Pass in eastern Arunachal Pradesh lies at the India–China–Myanmar tri-junction. Nathu La and Jelep La are India–China (Tibet) passes in Sikkim, and Shipki La is in Himachal Pradesh.

s: Which one of the following statements is not correct in respect of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)?
o: Its Headquarters is located in Kathmandu.
China is the only country with an Observer status in SAARC.
The First SAARC Summit was held in Dhaka.
The Eighteenth SAARC Summit was held in Nepal.
x: SAARC has nine observers (Australia, China, EU, Iran, Japan, South Korea, Mauritius, Myanmar, USA), so 'China is the only observer' is wrong. The HQ is in Kathmandu, the 1st Summit was at Dhaka (1985) and the 18th was at Kathmandu, Nepal (2014).
note: Option d duplicated option c; restored the original d ('The Eighteenth SAARC Summit was held in Nepal.') from CDS 2017 (I), 5 Feb 2017. The key stays b.
